product_brief: A comprehensive suite of FIPS Approved algorithms implemented in pure Java.
pqc_capability_description: The document lists approved and non-approved algorithms including AES, RSA, DSA, ECDSA, SHA, and various KDFs/KAS schemes. There is no mention of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms (e.g., CRYSTALS-Kyber, CRYSTALS-Dilithium, SPHINCS+) or PQC migration plans.
crypto_primitives: AES, DSA, ECDSA, RSA, SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3, HMAC, DRBG (Counter, Hash, HMAC), KAS-FFC, KAS-ECC, KAS-IFC, KTS-IFC, PBKDF, KDF (HKDF, SP800-108, etc.), cSHAKE, KMAC, TupleHash, ParallelHash
key_management_model: Software-based cryptographic library; keys generated via DRBG or key agreement/transport primitives within the module boundary.
architecture_type: Software Cryptographic Module (Multi-Chip Stand Alone embodiment)
primary_platforms: VMware Photon OS, HP-UX, Linux (Centos, Debian, Fedora, Oracle RHC/UEK, Photon, SUSE, Ubuntu, ClevOS), Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Mac OS X, Microsoft Windows (XP, Server), Solaris, AIX
target_industries: US Federal agencies and other markets requiring FIPS 140-3 validation
signature_schemes: DSA, ECDSA, RSA (PKCS#1 v2.1 PSS and PKCS1.5)
testing_&_validation_methods: CAVP tested (Certificate A4399); FIPS 140-3 Validated; Pre-Operational and Conditional Self-Tests
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Uses Approved DRBGs (Counter, Hash, HMAC) compliant with SP 800-90Ar1; supports External RNG; guidance provided for configuring JVM's Entropy Source
